title: Wi-Fi survey request, Rouen
summary: A partner that normally supports Evernex with Wi-Fi surveys asked Evernex for help at a site in Rouen. Sales declined: the company is registered as a partner, not as a customer, and would have to be set up as a customer first.

timeline.text: Partner management takes the request and contacts the partner.
Partner asks again whether there is interest.
Declined for now: registration as a customer would be needed first.

suggest.reason: Site in France: EMEA defaults. The request was declined, so no assignment may be needed.
